confidence_notes: Dining estimates use [Geomaxxing](https://geomaxxing.org/cost-of-living/cuba/trinidad/) and [TruePrice](https://truepriceapp.com/en/countries/cuba/) data reported after July; historical prices, exchange-rate differences, and shortages add uncertainty. Cocktail and wine are estimated at a premium to beer. Accommodation is modeled, and registered dorm beds may be scarce.
comparable_city_reasoning: The estimates consider Cuban tourist centers and Trinidad's heritage-tourism demand, including its market for private guesthouses.
